The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Ajunta Pall]] used a '''lightsaber''' before [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|death]]. According to legend, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] took possession of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] after his death and stored it inside the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]].<ref name="FDCR" />
